primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: Greedy Maw use has a per-player 30 s cooldown, consumes Mortal Essence and may reduce defense by 2. It stores use-time+15 s; the growth helper adds another 15 s, so the next growth is no earlier than use-time+30 s (subject to think scheduling). Player use/cooldown and the shared timestamp gate remain unbound.

primary_source_findings_applied.old_resolution: A Greedy Eye owns the direction-bound 'greedy eye beam' creature ability; the beam stays in Creature/Ability authoring rather than being duplicated as an encounter rule.
primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: A Greedy Eye registers the greedy eye beam attack. Registration alone does not certify canonical Ability behavior or facing geometry.

primary_source_findings_applied.old_resolution: Crystal defines the Ashes/Spark/Flame/Blaze thresholds at 180/135/90/45 seconds.
primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: Crystal defines the Ashes/Spark/Flame/Blaze thresholds at 180/135/90/45 seconds.

primary_source_findings_applied.old_resolution: BurningChangeForm advances Ashes -> Spark -> Flame -> Blaze -> Ashes; the Blaze reset requires the extra reset tick, represented by a 46 second Blaze timer. New Ashes adds +10 hatred.
primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: BurningChangeForm compares the shared pre-decrement time to form thresholds. The initial Ashes transition occurs on callback 46, and Sorrow can raise time across earlier thresholds. The forward-only draft timers are not exact counter/phase equivalence.

primary_source_findings_applied.old_resolution: Every Aspect death counts while the boss is Purple and schedules a replacement at the boss position after 5 seconds.
primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: Unmastered Aspect deaths count only in Purple and schedule a replacement after 5 s. The donor captures the boss position at death; delayed role_position resolves it later and cannot certify that captured-position behavior.

primary_source_findings_applied.old_resolution: Purple/Green/Blue onThink loops also drive torment, procedural white tiles, defense growth and the custom elemental transformation; these remain separate hard holds.
primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: Purple onThink drives torment, procedural white tiles and defense state. These hooks remain separate hard holds; they do not prove elemental spell behavior.

primary_source_findings_applied.old_resolution: Megalomania death records the quest kill flag for credited killers; the encounter exposes boss_defeated and leaves persistent quest state to Quest authoring.
primary_source_findings_applied.new_resolution: MegalomaniaDeath is registered by Green and Blue, not Purple. The core exposes its outcome only outside the Purple phase; persistent flags and final credit remain Quest-owned.
